The strongest customer-ranking and Kingston evidence found is secondary reporting; the Micron ranking's period, denominator, and underlying figures are not disclosed.
The NVIDIA evidence concerns PTI services for Micron on a product customized for NVIDIA; it does not prove a direct PTI-NVIDIA customer relationship.
The SK Hynix report says close cooperation but does not identify a specific order or purchased service.
The Kioxia order report is explicitly unconfirmed market-rumor reporting.
No reliable evidence found in this review resolves every listed company's direct/current customer status.
